dialogues.speaker: Ancient Swordsman's Inscriptions (V)
dialogues.text: "...Pot in hand, I admired the clouds atop a mountaintop, cutting branches to make swords, eating melons, fish, and rice cakes. I exulted with cloud and mist, and..."

dialogues.speaker: Ancient Swordsman's Inscriptions (V)
dialogues.text: "...A disciple suddenly appeared, with swift draw and lightning-quick blade. I fended it off with a wooden comb, and with my stick-sword I struck out and thereupon parted. Laughing, I sang..."
